verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core product is journey/automation building that runs autonomously in the background, triggered by events or segment membership, independent of user presence (docs-12, docs-13, docs-18), and this can even be managed/listed via AI/MCP tooling (docs-9). This is well-documented first-party functionality central to the platform's purpose. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that automations run reliably at scale without manual intervention (community evidence only discusses unrelated outages/bugs, not automation autonomy specifically).
